services.title: Electrical installation
services.lede: Complete electrical installation for commercial buildings, institutions, hospitality developments and homes.
services.body: Design, first fix, second fix, distribution boards, testing and certification. We work with leading contractors and architects across the private and public sectors — banks, office buildings, hotels and lodges, healthcare facilities, industrial projects and residential housing.

services.title: Electronic security & surveillance
services.lede: CCTV, intruder alarm and access control systems, installed and commissioned.
services.body: Camera coverage planned around the building rather than bolted on afterwards, with cabling run alongside the electrical installation so nothing is retrofitted through finished walls.

services.title: Solar power & photovoltaics
services.lede: Solar power generation and photovoltaic cell installation.
services.body: Generation tied into the building distribution properly, with the switching and protection designed for it rather than adapted around it.

services.title: UPS, AVR & surge protection
services.lede: Uninterrupted power supply systems, automatic voltage regulators and surge protectors.
services.body: For sites where an outage or a spike is expensive — data rooms, healthcare equipment, hospitality operations. Sized to the actual load, not the nameplate.

services.title: Lifts, escalators & conveyors
services.lede: Lifts, hoists, escalators, mechanical ramps, travolators, conveyors and belt installation.
services.body: Installation and the electrical infrastructure that carries it, coordinated with the main contractor programme.

services.title: Transmission & distribution
services.lede: Construction of power transmission lines and installation of power distribution equipment.
services.body: Getting supply to the site and distributing it once it arrives, including the switchgear that protects it.

services.title: Energy efficiency retrofitting
services.lede: Retrofitting existing installations to reduce consumption.
services.body: Surveying what a building currently draws, then replacing the parts of the installation where the savings actually are — rather than replacing everything and hoping.

services.title: Compressed air, hydraulics & gas
services.lede: Compressed air, hydraulic, LPG and mechanical gas installation.
services.body: Specialist services installed to the same standard and certification as the electrical work, by the same team.

faqs.question: What kind of projects do you take on?
faqs.answer: Electrical installation across the corporate, commercial and residential markets — banks and commercial interiors, office buildings, institutions, hotels, lodges and resorts, industrial projects, health care facilities, and residential housing from single homes to multi-unit developments.

faqs.question: Are you registered?
faqs.answer: Premier Power Limited is registered with the National Construction Authority as an Electrical Engineering Service Contractor. That registration covers electrical installation, electronic security and surveillance, lifts and escalators, solar power generation and photovoltaics, compressed air and gas installation, UPS and surge protection, energy-efficiency retrofitting, and the construction of power transmission lines.

faqs.question: Do you work outside Nairobi?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work on projects all over the country — recent and current work includes Nanyuki and Laikipia, Meru, Mua Hills, Mlolongo and the Maasai Mara, alongside Nairobi. We are expanding our operations regionally.

faqs.question: Do you work with main contractors and architects?
faqs.answer: Almost always. We undertake electrical installation with a number of leading contractors in both the private and public sectors, and coordinate directly with the project architect — Seltar Crafts, Designspec, Construe Consultants and N.A Projects International among them.

faqs.question: Can you handle more than the electrical installation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Security and access control, solar photovoltaics, UPS and voltage regulation, lifts and escalators, and gas installation all sit inside our NCA registration. Putting them with one contractor means one programme and one point of responsibility rather than four subcontractors coordinating between themselves.

faqs.question: What does a site assessment cost?
faqs.answer: Nothing. We visit, review the drawings or the existing installation, and come back with a written scope. There is no obligation.

faqs.question: What happens if something fails after handover?
faqs.answer: Our workmanship is warranted and the terms are stated plainly rather than buried in a contract. Faults that trace back to our installation are our cost to correct.
